description: This file defines a Perl module 'Git::SVN::Editor' that implements a commit driver for 'git svn set-tree' and dcommit. It is an object-oriented Perl class inheriting from SVN::Delta::Editor, providing methods to generate diffs, modify SVN repository content, and synchronize changes between git and SVN repositories. The file includes code for applying diffs, handling file operations, properties, and connections to SVN and git internals.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Editor
classes.description: A Perl class implementing a commit editor for 'git svn' operations, inheriting from SVN::Delta::Editor, providing methods to generate and apply diffs, manage SVN repository changes, and facilitate synchronization between git and SVN.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the editor with options, setting up SVN commit editor, diff parameters, and internal state.

methods.name: generate_diff
methods.description: Generates a diff between two git trees, returning an array of modifications.

methods.name: check_diff_paths
methods.description: Checks the repository paths for the differences as indicated by the diff mods.

methods.name: split_path
methods.description: Splits a path into directory and filename components.

methods.name: repo_path
methods.description: Returns the repository path, applying charset encoding if configured.

methods.name: url_path
methods.description: Returns the full URL path for a given repo path.

methods.name: rmdirs
